title: Mirror-y admissibility gate for RealPDEBench NACA0025 foil fields

source_case.sim_id: Re_AoA.h5, where AoA is read from *_params_*.json

parameters.coordinate_rule: y -> -y about the empirically verified centerline
parameters.pressure_rule: p -> p when numerical pressure is available
parameters.angle_of_attack_rule: admissible candidate only when AoA = 0.0 degrees

transformation_preconditions: The RealPDEBench foil metadata explicitly provides angle of attack and Reynolds number for the source case.
The source case has AoA = 0.0 degrees before mirror-y can be considered admissible.
The coordinate arrays expose a y-axis and an empirically verifiable reflection centerline.
The grid or interpolation map has a bounded reflection/mapping floor.
Velocity components use the documented x/y ordering: u is x velocity and v is y velocity.
The source and follow-up fields are compared at matched time indices.

boundary_condition_compatibility.reason: NACA 00xx foil geometry supplies a plausible symmetry prior, and RealPDEBench metadata contains zero-AoA foil cases, but the MR is admitted only after coordinate symmetry and measurement/mapping floor checks pass. Non-zero AoA cases are rejected by physical precondition.

output_mapping.description: Reflect the follow-up field about the verified y-centerline and compare u directly while comparing v with sign reversal. Numerical pressure, when available, is compared without sign reversal.

metric.name: realpdebench_foil_mirror_relative_l2_error
floor_terms: interpolation error if reflected coordinates do not land exactly on grid points
measurement noise for real PIV fields
real/simulation modality mismatch when comparing paired data

tolerance.source: metadata-screen precommitment; no outcome-dependent tolerance allowed

exclusion_rules: Reject non-zero angle-of-attack source cases as out-of-relation-domain for exact mirror-y.
Reject cases whose AoA, velocity-component convention, coordinate axes, or time index cannot be verified from metadata.
Defer cases where the reflection/mapping floor dominates any proposed verdict tolerance.
Do not compare real and numerical modalities as an exact MR unless a modality-mismatch floor is explicitly bounded.

verdict_interpretation.skip: The run was not executed because prerequisites or metadata were unavailable.
verdict_interpretation.out-of-relation-domain: AoA, geometry, boundary, coordinate, or component preconditions were not met.
verdict_interpretation.numerical-tolerance-issue: The result was dominated by numerical mapping or interpolation uncertainty.
verdict_interpretation.inconclusive: The metadata or runtime evidence was insufficient for pass/fail classification.

claim_limitations: This card precommits a RealPDEBench foil mirror-y admissibility gate. It does not report a SUT verdict, real-defect detection, production CFD validation, broad aerodynamic generalization, or model reliability.
